name: Azorus IV Episode One
source: Join Captain Rousseau and company as a routine patrol through the Azorus Sector goes straight to hell. Decide your own destiny in this piece of fast-paced interactive fiction. Fans of visual novels know what they're in for. As for the rest, prep for an immersive adventure on a level you've never seen before. Rich visuals and audio collide to help put you inside the cockpit, just try not to get yourself killed. With 5 unique endings and high-quality anime character artwork, this first episode of the Azorus IV saga won't disappoint.
translation:
加入卢梭舰长一行，亲历一次彻底变成地狱的阿佐鲁斯星区例行巡逻。在这部节奏明快的互动小说中，亲手决定自己的命运。视觉小说玩家自然知道前方有什么；其他人则请准备迎接前所未见的沉浸式冒险。

丰富视听效果将你直接带入驾驶舱——只要别害死自己。本作拥有五种独特结局与高品质动画风角色插画，《Azorus IV》传奇的第一集不会令人失望。
